text:
Type: terracotta plant pot with saucer
Use: growing a potted plant on a windowsill, floor or shelf; living room, kitchen, balcony
Style: rustic, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: unglazed terracotta clay, matching saucer
Colors: warm terracotta orange, earthy clay
Shape: classic round pot tapering toward the base, thick rim, deep matching saucer, simple and sturdy, medium size
Feel: earthy, warm, natural, homey
Goes with: green leafy plants, white walls, light wood, linen; rustic, farmhouse, Mediterranean or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: INGEFRA
product.description: The porous terracotta holds excess water, so the plant can draw out moisture when needed.
